en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing the storefront of a jeweler/watchmaker named Karl Karner. The facade has large windows filled with watches and silverware, a hanging clock, and several signs in Slovene. The reverse is a printed advertising back giving the business details: Karl Karner, jeweler and engraver in Maribor, Slovenska ulica 3, with a large stock of gold, silverware, and watches. There is a library stamp and a pencil note with an approximate date.
